summary: Wombat now brings real-task Harness trials to the installed Codex plugin on Apple silicon Macs. Compare project instructions, confirm a change, and check it in a fresh session.
highlights: Run the same selected task with the original instructions, a general candidate, a domain candidate, and a composed version. Compare actual deliverables and independent checks.
Apply a reviewed version of the project instructions, confirm that a new Codex session loads it, and undo the change. Wombat reports a conflict if the target file has changed since application.
Start from the existing Wombat Skill. Trial sessions reuse the current Codex login and use separate writable workspaces with read-only selected inputs.
knownLimitations: Trials require an Apple silicon Mac and an existing Codex login. They compare the project-root AGENTS.md using selected UTF-8 inputs.
One trial uses four task runs and two editorial sessions. Existing global instructions require trial-specific approval.
